title: Digital Footprint Request Letter Template
metaDescription: Professional template to request information about your digital footprint from companies. Get clarity on what data exists about you online.
description: A comprehensive letter template to formally request information about your digital footprint from companies, websites, and data brokers. Helps you understand what personal information is being collected and stored about you online.

sections.content:

sections.heading: Subject Line and Salutation
sections.content:
Subject: Request for Information About My Digital Footprint and Personal Data

Dear Privacy Officer/Data Protection Officer,

sections.heading: Introduction and Purpose
sections.content:
I am writing to request information about my digital footprint and any personal data your organization may have collected, processed, or stored about me. As a privacy-conscious individual, I want to understand what information exists about me in your systems and how it is being used.

I am making this request under applicable privacy laws and regulations, including but not limited to the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA), General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), and other relevant data protection statutes.

sections.heading: Specific Information Request
sections.content:
Please provide me with the following information regarding my digital footprint in your systems:

1. All personal data you have collected about me, including:
 - Contact information (name, email, phone, address)
 - Online identifiers (IP addresses, device IDs, cookies)
 - Behavioral data (website visits, clicks, preferences)
 - Location data and tracking information
 - Social media profiles or connections
 - Any inferred or derived information about me

2. The sources from which this data was obtained
3. The purposes for which my data is being processed
4. Any third parties with whom my data has been shared
5. The retention period for my personal data
6. Any automated decision-making or profiling conducted using my data

sections.heading: Account Information
sections.content:
To help you locate my information in your systems, please find my account details below:

- Email address associated with account: [your_email]
- Username (if applicable): [your_username]
- Phone number: [your_phone]
- Approximate date of account creation: [account_date]
- Any other relevant identifiers: [other_identifiers]

sections.heading: Response Timeline and Format
sections.content:
I would appreciate receiving this information within 30 days of this request, as required by applicable privacy laws. Please provide the information in a commonly used electronic format that allows me to review and understand my digital footprint comprehensively.

If you require additional information to verify my identity or process this request, please contact me at the email address or phone number provided above.

sections.heading: Closing and Signature
sections.content:
Thank you for your attention to this matter and your commitment to data privacy. I look forward to your prompt response.

If you have any questions or need clarification about this request, please don't hesitate to contact me.

Sincerely,

[Your Signature]
[Your Printed Name]
[Date]

useCases: Job seekers wanting to audit their online presence before applications
Parents checking what data companies have collected about their children
Professionals managing their digital reputation and footprint
Individuals preparing to delete or minimize their online presence
People who suspect unauthorized data collection or sharing
Privacy-conscious users conducting regular digital footprint audits
